title: Turn sending telemetry to application insights on or off

facts.text: Generally available for Business Central online and on-premises
Microsoft Azure subscription and Application Insights resource are required to send telemetry
For version 17 and earlier, copy the Instrumentation Key; for later versions, copy the Connection String from Azure portal
Connection string has maximum length of 2,048 characters
Instrumentation key support ends 31 March 2025; transition to connection strings required by that date
For online environments, enable telemetry from admin center by selecting Environments, defining Application Insights Key, and saving to trigger environment restart
For on-premises single-tenant, use Set-NAVServerConfiguration cmdlet to set Application Insights Connection String or Instrumentation Key
For on-premises multitenant, use Mount-NAVTenant cmdlet with ApplicationInsightsConnectionString or ApplicationInsightsKey parameters when mounting tenants
